rationale: David brings deep expertise in shipping production robotics systems (drones, tractors, autonomous vehicles) and is now building real-time infrastructure at LiveKit to solve the exact comms and observability gaps he encountered in the field—while Luke is a full-stack founding engineer with ML infrastructure experience who has worked across industrial automation and neural networks. At a physical AI hackathon, David's conviction that production robotics requires purpose-built real-time infrastructure and observability could directly inform how Luke approaches building or architecting systems that bridge AI models with physical hardware.
intro_message: David Chen, meet Luke Bechtel — David's shipping real-time infrastructure for robotics at LiveKit after years as CTO of autonomous systems companies, and Luke's a founding engineer with ML infra and industrial automation background who could benefit from his production robotics shipping expertise.
